import ctypes, errno, fcntl, os, select, signal, socket, struct, subprocess, sys, time
# Deterministic clock for a bash build under test (disposable parity VM, unprivileged).
# usage: clockinj.py OUTFILE KEYSFILE BASH SCRIPT
#  - the child is traced from exec: at the exec stop the auxv AT_SYSINFO_EHDR entry is overwritten with AT_IGNORE so libc
#    cannot use the vDSO and issues real clock_gettime / clock_nanosleep system calls;
#  - a seccomp user-notification filter stops clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) and clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC);
#    this supervisor answers from a virtual clock that advances only when the child sleeps (absolute sleeps jump to the deadline);
#  - on every sleep (one per game frame) the next line of KEYSFILE (python-literal bytes) is written to the child's stdin pipe.
ALLOW = 0x7fff0000
NOTIFY = 0x7fc00000
CMP_EQ = 4
NOTIF_RECV = 0xc0502100
NOTIF_SEND = 0xc0182101
SYS_CLOCK_GETTIME, SYS_CLOCK_NANOSLEEP = 228, 230
T0 = 1000 * 10**9
class ArgCmp(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("arg", ctypes.c_uint), ("op", ctypes.c_int), ("datum_a", ctypes.c_uint64), ("datum_b", ctypes.c_uint64)]
out_path, keys_path, bash, script = sys.argv[1:5]
keys = [eval(l) for l in open(keys_path).read().splitlines() if l.strip()] if keys_path != '-' else []
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
libc.ptrace.argtypes = [ctypes.c_long, ctypes.c_long, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
libc.ptrace.restype = ctypes.c_long
lib = ctypes.CDLL("libseccomp.so.2", use_errno=True)
lib.seccomp_init.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
lib.seccomp_init.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint32]
lib.seccomp_rule_add_array.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.POINTER(ArgCmp)]
lib.seccomp_load.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
lib.seccomp_notify_fd.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
parent, peer = socket.socketpair(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
in_r, in_w = os.pipe()
out_fd = os.open(out_path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o644)
child = os.fork()
if child == 0:
    try:
        parent.close(); os.close(in_w)
        os.dup2(in_r, 0); os.dup2(out_fd, 1)
        libc.ptrace(0, 0, None, None)                       # PTRACE_TRACEME
        libc.prctl(38, 1, 0, 0, 0)                          # PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS
        ctx = lib.seccomp_init(ALLOW)
        for nr in (SYS_CLOCK_GETTIME, SYS_CLOCK_NANOSLEEP):
            cmp_ = (ArgCmp * 1)(ArgCmp(0, CMP_EQ, 1, 0))
            assert lib.seccomp_rule_add_array(ctx, ctypes.c_uint32(NOTIFY), nr, 1, cmp_) == 0
        assert lib.seccomp_load(ctx) == 0
        listener = lib.seccomp_notify_fd(ctx)
        os.set_inheritable(listener, False)
        socket.send_fds(peer, [b"L"], [listener])
        os.execv(bash, [bash, '--noprofile', '--norc', '-c', script])
    except BaseException as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("clockinj child: %r\n" % (exc,))
    os._exit(126)
peer.close(); os.close(in_r); os.close(out_fd)
select.select([parent], [], [], 10)
_, fds, _, _ = socket.recv_fds(parent, 16, 1)
listener = fds[0]
pid, st = os.waitpid(child, 0)                              # exec SIGTRAP stop
assert os.WIFSTOPPED(st), st
regs = (ctypes.c_ulonglong * 27)()
assert libc.ptrace(12, child, None, ctypes.byref(regs)) == 0   # PTRACE_GETREGS
rsp = regs[19]
mem = os.open('/proc/%d/mem' % child, os.O_RDWR)
def rd(addr, n): return os.pread(mem, n, addr)
argc = struct.unpack('<Q', rd(rsp, 8))[0]
p = rsp + 8 * (argc + 2)
while struct.unpack('<Q', rd(p, 8))[0]:
    p += 8
p += 8                                                       # auxv
patched = 0
while True:
    typ, val = struct.unpack('<QQ', rd(p, 16))
    if typ == 0:
        break
    if typ == 33:
        os.pwrite(mem, struct.pack('<Q', 1), p); patched += 1   # AT_SYSINFO_EHDR -> AT_IGNORE
    p += 16
assert patched == 1, patched
assert libc.ptrace(17, child, None, None) == 0              # PTRACE_DETACH
memfds = {}
def memfd(pid, flags):
    k = (pid, flags)
    if k not in memfds:
        memfds[k] = os.open('/proc/%d/mem' % pid, flags)
    return memfds[k]
vclock = T0
frames = 0
if keys and keys[0]:
    os.write(in_w, keys[0])
log = []
status = None
while status is None:
    done, wait = os.waitpid(child, os.WNOHANG)
    if done:
        status = wait; break
    ready, _, _ = select.select([listener], [], [], 0.05)
    if not ready:
        continue
    req = bytearray(80)
    try:
        fcntl.ioctl(listener, NOTIF_RECV, req, True)
    except OSError as exc:
        if exc.errno in (errno.ENOENT, errno.EINTR):
            continue
        raise
    ident, npid, _f, nr, _a, _ip = struct.unpack_from("<QIIiIQ", req)
    args = struct.unpack_from("<6Q", req, 32)
    if nr == SYS_CLOCK_GETTIME:
        os.pwrite(memfd(npid, os.O_RDWR), struct.pack('<qq', vclock // 10**9, vclock % 10**9), args[1])
    elif nr == SYS_CLOCK_NANOSLEEP:
        sec, nsec = struct.unpack('<qq', os.pread(memfd(npid, os.O_RDWR), 16, args[2]))
        t = sec * 10**9 + nsec
        vclock = max(vclock, t) if args[1] & 1 else vclock + t
        frames += 1
        k = keys[frames] if frames < len(keys) else b''
        if k:
            os.write(in_w, k)
    try:
        fcntl.ioctl(listener, NOTIF_SEND, struct.pack("<QqiI", ident, 0, 0, 0))
    except OSError as exc:
        if exc.errno != errno.ENOENT:
            raise
os.close(in_w)
open('inj.status', 'w').write('exit=%s sleeps=%d vclock_ms=%d\n' % (os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status), frames, (vclock - T0) // 10**6))

NOTIF_RECV = 0xc0502100
NOTIF_SEND = 0xc0182101
SYS_CLOCK_GETTIME, SYS_CLOCK_NANOSLEEP = 228, 230
T0 = 1000 * 10**9

    _fields_ = [("arg", ctypes.c_uint), ("op", ctypes.c_int), ("datum_a", ctypes.c_uint64), ("datum_b", ctypes.c_uint64)]

keys = [eval(l) for l in open(keys_path).read().splitlines() if l.strip()] if keys_path != '-' else []

libc.ptrace.argtypes = [ctypes.c_long, ctypes.c_long, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
libc.ptrace.restype = ctypes.c_long

lib.seccomp_init.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
lib.seccomp_init.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint32]
lib.seccomp_rule_add_array.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.POINTER(ArgCmp)]
lib.seccomp_load.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
lib.seccomp_notify_fd.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
